Every entry is a site OUTSIDE the SSH transport (internal/ssh,
internal/helper/sshsvc, internal/sshtest) that decides a fact about an SSH
connection: it imports x/crypto/ssh, dials a network, reads an ExitError or
sends a keepalive. ADR-ba6xet1b says a connection fact has one owner — the
backend's connection manager behind the Carrier interface — and the stages of
nocx-oalo1 remove these. The list may only SHRINK: the updater refuses growth
without --allow-growth, and an entry with no reason fails the check.
Keyed on rule + file + the trimmed line, not a line number, so an unrelated
edit above a baselined line does not make this file churn — the tradeoff
check-log-context.mjs makes for its own baseline. A line whose text changes is
a new site, and its reason has to be carried over by hand.
